templates.name: Static site build output verification
templates.description: Procedure: Run the build on a representative notes folder. Verify build completes without errors. Confirm output directory contains only static assets (HTML/CSS/JS/media) and can be opened from a local file server and/or deployed to a chosen static host without backend services. Pass criteria: Build exits successfully; output contains no server-side executables/configs; site pages render in browser from static hosting or local serving with core functionality available.

templates.name: Markdown fidelity rendering check
templates.description: Procedure: Prepare a test note set covering headings, lists, code blocks, blockquotes, links, images, and tables per selected Markdown flavor. Build site and compare rendered HTML against expected structure. Pass criteria: All elements render correctly and consistently across notes with no loss of formatting.

templates.name: Full-text search relevance
templates.description: Procedure: Define a query set with expected target notes. Build site and execute queries via UI. Capture top 10 results for each. Pass criteria: ≥90% of queries return expected note within top 10 results; zero client-side errors during search.

templates.name: Tag extraction and navigation
templates.description: Procedure: Create dataset with tagged and untagged notes using the specified tag syntax. Build site and open tag index/filters. Pass criteria: 100% of tagged notes appear under each corresponding tag; untagged notes do not appear under any tag; tag links are navigable.

templates.name: Backlinks computation and display
templates.description: Procedure: Prepare notes with known link graph (A→B, C→B, B→D). Build site. On each note page, verify backlinks list contains all and only notes that link to it. Pass criteria: 100% expected backlinks appear; no false backlinks.

templates.name: Forward link resolution
templates.description: Procedure: Create notes with internal links using specified syntax. Build site and click through internal links. Pass criteria: All internal links resolve to correct target pages; broken links are reported or handled per spec.

templates.name: Cross-browser static functionality
templates.description: Procedure: Open generated site in latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge. Validate navigation, search, tags, backlinks. Pass criteria: No console errors; core features function consistently.

templates.name: Build and search performance targets
templates.description: Procedure: Use representative dataset size. Measure build time and client-side search response time for agreed targets. Pass criteria: Metrics meet agreed thresholds.

templates.name: Link Syntax Handling
templates.description: Test the tool with the agreed Markdown flavor and link syntax (e.g., CommonMark/GFM, standard Markdown links, [[WikiLinks]]). Verify correct parsing, rendering, and backlink computation for all supported link formats. Confirm unsupported formats are handled gracefully (ignored or flagged).

templates.name: Tag Representation Handling
templates.description: Test tag extraction and rendering using the agreed tag representation (YAML frontmatter, inline #tags, or both). Verify correct parsing, indexing, and navigation. If nested tags are supported, confirm hierarchy is preserved.

templates.name: Build Workflow and Environment
templates.description: Verify that the build tool runs successfully in the target OS environments (to be specified) and supports the preferred workflow (CLI, watch mode, git-based build). Confirm installation, configuration, and execution steps are documented and repeatable.

templates.name: Input File Assumptions
templates.description: Confirm that the tool correctly reads Markdown files from a local filesystem or repository as input. Test with various directory structures, file encodings, and edge cases (empty files, missing frontmatter, special characters in filenames).

coverage_guidance: Ensure test datasets include edge cases: empty notes folder, single note, large note set, and notes with special characters/Unicode.
Include notes with duplicate titles and file names to verify unique URL/slug handling per spec.
Verify behavior for missing or malformed frontmatter/tag syntax per chosen standard.
Include mixed internal link formats if multiple syntaxes are supported; otherwise ensure unsupported syntax is documented and handled.
Validate that search index and assets are referenced with relative paths that work on static hosts and local file servers.
Check that generated site does not depend on network access for core features unless explicitly allowed.
Confirm that backlinks and tags update correctly when notes are added/removed between builds.
Ensure acceptance tests cover all success metrics (SM1-SM7) with measurable pass criteria.
Validate constraints CNS1 and CNS2: output must be static and input must be standard Markdown.
Include tests for non-goals to verify they are explicitly NOT implemented (e.g., no server-side runtime, no real-time editing).
Test interoperability: generated site must work across target browsers and hosting platforms.
Performance tests should establish baseline metrics and be repeatable as the project scales.

Acceptance tests should be automatable where possible (build success, link/backlink accuracy, tag extraction) and include manual verification steps where needed (visual rendering, cross-browser checks).
definition_of_done: All QA templates executed with passing results on representative dataset.
Blocking open questions (Markdown flavor, link syntax, tag syntax) resolved and tests updated accordingly.
Success metrics SM1–SM6 met; SM7 met once performance targets are defined.
No critical or high severity defects remain; medium defects have documented remediation plan.
Build output verified as fully static and deployable to chosen static hosting target.
Documentation includes setup, build, and deployment instructions verified via ATT11.
Non-goals (NG1-NG7) are confirmed as out-of-scope and not implemented.
Performance baseline is established for generation time and search responsiveness on agreed dataset scale.
Any deviations from success metrics or unresolved blocking questions are explicitly documented and approved by stakeholders.
